meta.title: Cart View (PR Route): refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as the configured non-Buyer and verify Cart View is refused or absent, including the cart's selected PR lines, delete control, and quantity-reduce control.
Repeat the Cart View check as a Buyer in the same tenant and verify it is available with delete and quantity-reduce controls.
Determine whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants Cart View to additional roles.
